rationales.aesthetic_similarity: The same-session bedroom capture preserves the reference furniture placement and viewpoint. Large pure-white cutaway surroundings, harsher floor lighting, flatter surfaces, and less nuanced window lighting visibly diverge from the reference.
rationales.action_sfx_integrity: The detective moves to the wardrobe and its door opens, and the bed cover changes position; the wardrobe view obscures the arm at the door edge and the bed action lacks a visible hand-to-cover connection. The score covers visible motion only; sound effects were not independently auditioned.
rationales.narrative_flow: Object markers and the labeled bedroom door guided exploration into the corridor. The opening question and the wardrobe line establish a mystery, while the bed inspection showed little clear evidence and the exit transitioned abruptly.

blocked_phases: No gameplay phase blocked; close response leaked nested current_scene after transition. Treat test as incomplete under blind isolation rule.
